newsitem.title: USA: Schering submits NDA for rhinitis spray.
newsitem.headline: Schering submits NDA for rhinitis spray.

text.p: Schering-Plough Corp said it submitted a New Drug Application to the U.S. Food And Drug Administration seeking clearance to market a once daily acqueous nasal spray for seasonal allergic rhinitis.
It also said it sought approval to market NASONEX for the treatement of perennial rhinitis in adults and children over 12 years of age.
NASONEX is mometasone furoate monohydrate, an anit-inflammatory corticosteroid discovered by Schering-Plough Research Insititute.
